title: Ash Lot Hoops
premise: Five friends take over the worst basketball club in town: a cracked parking lot, one rusty hoop and eleven fans. One small real step a day toward the big leagues, and the top comment decides what happens next.
rules: One small real step per episode. Small wins, real setbacks, no early triumphs.
Counters on screen come from series.json only. The fund grows by one rule: every OG fan puts in a dollar a week. It is story money, never an income claim.
Open on the problem inside 3 seconds, then breathe.
End on an open question the comments can answer in a few words.

next.brief: Day 1: the court is a cracked lot. End on the question of what to fix first.
